output.reason: [ev-f83dc72c2c99] groups four separate changes under one "Breaking API (Manual Migration Needed)" heading: Ubuntu is dropped as an AMI family, the do-not-consolidate and do-not-evict annotations are removed, the managed-by tag is replaced by eks:eks-cluster-name, and the disruption taint is renamed. The evidence names an operator step only for the taint ("you'll need to adjust your taints"). It does not say what happens to Ubuntu users or to resources that still carry the removed annotations or tag, so one migration-required consequence does not fit all four. The proposed statement also leaves out the Ubuntu change, and its remediation adds steps the evidence does not give, such as telling operators to remove the annotations from Node resources. The cluster should be split into separate changes before any consequence is assigned.
